subject: hm-pdf-plan
description: pdf-sdk's plan document (docs/formats/hm-pdf-plan.md). input is an hm-pdf-plan document; expected is the document as a reader writes it back, or the rejection. Positions and sizes are whole millionths of the page. Generated cases come from the reducer's property-test generators, with a fixed seed.
